suggestions.name: BT Group plc
suggestions.suggestion: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags and intra-year coverage are true. For BT-A.L they are not: period_coverage annual=8/interim=0/trading_update=1 is eight Companies House group accounts (2019–2026) plus one mis-tagged ‘Across The Markets’ wrap, while the live 22 Jul 2026 REG Trading Statement and 29 Jun Verizon JV exist only as news headlines. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps. Headline-only news therefore carries the only post-FY26 operating prints, ranked below empty quarterlies.

suggestions.suggestion: Four worker types plus a five-task cap force one (or two) CH annual bodies + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for a later-ingested Q1 TU, the Verizon JV RNS, or FY26 prelim slides.
